plan.title: A maintenance check-in folded into the kickoff, and "mostly" taken lightly

transcript.text: Kalimera Priya! Five days straight, so tonight it's 20 push-ups and 30 squats at home at 6, same as before. And are you still getting lights out by 10:30?
on it! and mostly, missed one night this week lol
Ha, one slip in a week still counts as keeping it up 😄 Go get it at 6, and send me the watch workout screenshot when you're done.

checks.reason: The bedtime check is one light line folded into the kickoff, not a second push.
Three short sentences, one question, placed at the end.
"one slip in a week still counts as keeping it up" takes the "mostly" lightly, with no guilt or lecture.
Two sentences pointing back to today's workout, with no question.

conversation.reason: The kickoff names 20 push-ups and 30 squats with one bedtime line as its only question, and the reply takes "mostly" lightly without a push.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the maintenance check-in well: the kickoff named today's workout and folded in one light bedtime question, with no pressure. The follow-up took "mostly, missed one night" lightly and stayed short, pointing back to the 6 pm workout.
